user.title: General settings
user.description: Configure Streaming Top FR. Advanced settings can later be changed from **Settings → Devices & services → Streaming Top FR → Configure**.

data_description.update_hours: Interval between automatic updates, from 2 to 168 hours (7 days).

services.title: Streaming services
services.description: Enable only the subscriptions you want to use. Rental and purchase offers are ignored.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: Configure carousel size and reserve depth.

top_catalog.title: Top Streaming / IMDb
top_catalog.description: JustWatch France defines the local candidate pool; IMDb then ranks quality inside that pool.

decades.title: Decades
decades.description: Choose the default decade and the decades available in Top Streaming. The default decade is automatically kept enabled.

family.title: Family mode
family.description: Configure the Family branch of Top Streaming.

classification.title: Age ratings
classification.description: French ratings have priority. US fallback is used only when no usable French rating is available.

playback.title: Direct playback
playback.description: Direct playback is optional. Disable it to use Streaming Top FR only as a catalogue and media library.

player.title: Playback destination
player.description: Select the Home Assistant entities for your Android TV / Freebox Pop.

data.player_adb_player: Android Debug Bridge media player (optional, required for Netflix / Disney+ / Prime)

error.player_already_exists: A destination already uses this ID.

players.title: Playback destinations
players.description: Enable or disable direct playback, then manage playback destinations. Saved destinations are kept when direct playback is disabled.

data.player_adb_player: Android Debug Bridge media player (optional, required for Netflix / Disney+ / Prime)

summary.title: Settings summary

default_decade.title: Default decade
default_decade.description: Choose the decade shown automatically when the Top Streaming card opens. It will remain enabled.

local_library.title: Streaming Local
local_library.description: Configure SMB access used by Streaming Local and VLC. The internal Home Assistant scan path is preserved automatically and is no longer exposed in this screen. Configured credentials remain on the Home Assistant side and are never exposed to the card.

data_description.local_smb_base_uri: Example: smb://192.168.0.200/videos — without username or password.
data_description.local_smb_auth_mode: Choose VLC-saved credentials or credentials configured here. Configured credentials are recommended for direct ADB launch.
data_description.local_extensions: Comma-separated list, for example: mkv, avi, mp4, m4v
data_description.local_movies_folders: Folder names recognized as Movies, comma-separated.
data_description.local_series_folders: Folder names recognized as TV shows, comma-separated.
data_description.local_animation_folders: Folder names recognized as Animation, comma-separated.
data_description.local_documentaries_folders: Folder names recognized as Documentaries, comma-separated.
data_description.local_smb_username: Used only with “Streaming Top FR — configured credentials”.
data_description.local_smb_password: Used only with “Streaming Top FR — configured credentials”. The password is not sent to the Lovelace card.

playback.title: Direct playback
playback.description: Enable or disable direct playback actions. Saved destinations are kept when playback is disabled.

duration_filter.title: Filter by maximum movie runtime
duration_filter.description: Shows an optional filter in the Movie views of Streaming, Top Streaming and Streaming Local. The button stays inactive until the user enables it in the card.

data_description.duration_filter_enabled: Disable this option to hide the duration filter entirely from the cards.
data_description.duration_filter_max_minutes: Only movies with a known runtime strictly below this threshold are shown when the filter is active.

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.description: Enables detailed Streaming Top FR diagnostic traces. Keep disabled during normal use.

data_description.debug_enabled: Enables detailed integration logs and shows Streaming ↔ Local matching diagnostics in popups.

card_layout.title: Card layout
card_layout.description: The number of visible rows follows the actual width of each card. By default, “Show more” adds posters in batches. Infinite scroll can be enabled globally, then overridden per card in Lovelace.

data.layout_rows_medium: Rows — medium space (700–1199 px, tablet / narrow desktop card)
data.layout_rows_large: Rows — wide space (≥ 1200 px, wide desktop card)

error.player_already_exists: A destination already uses this ID.
